### The Pursuit of Happiness
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-march-29-2013.html
Passage: Philippians 1:21
Points:
- Pursuits centered on money, fame, power, or possessions foster paranoia, envy, arrogance, and greed.
- Worldly ambitions undermine genuine spiritual contentment and joy.
- Lasting satisfaction is found exclusively in Christ regardless of circumstances, life, or death.
- True happiness requires developing a life centered on and governed by Christ.

### Death and the Intermediate State
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/death-and-intermediate-state
Passage: Philippians 1:21-23
Points:
- Death entered through sin and causes genuine earthly grief, yet for Christians dying is ultimate gain.
- Leaving this body to be consciously present with Christ is far better than current earthly existence.
- Scripture refutes unconscious soul sleep, affirming believers immediately enter the Lord's holy presence.
- The intermediate state bridges our present life with the final, perfected bodily resurrection.
